title: DataCite Metadata Schema 4.7 and Versioning Guidance
bounded_claims: Versioned resources can use typed relations such as IsPreviousVersionOf, IsNewVersionOf, HasVersion and IsVersionOf.
Resource identity and version succession should be represented explicitly rather than inferred from titles.
non_authority_scope: Version relations for citable resources do not establish corporate acquisition, legal parentage or semantic ownership.
DataCite metadata does not qualify an implementation.
